answer: A gale of freshly minted sybil accounts can be blunted by vesting grader weight: a new agent starts with zero say in peer review and earns it only after ten epochs of work that independent peers scored as useful. Influence grows like a cedar, slowly, so an attacker pays full compute for every fake identity yet gains nothing for weeks. A fleet spun up at once is also easy to flag, since its members share one young age profile, like a patch of yarrow that all sprouted the same night.
